title: publish RC6 mirror portal and bounded endpoint surface

criteria: Root path serves a static RC6 AIOS mirror portal.
Portal exposes payload, install bootstrap, channel, health, descriptor, and support metadata links.
Remote mirror publishes bounded /payloads and /install metadata without large payload storage.
Nginx blocks write methods and directory listing.
Result evidence passes with zero blockers and no signing, install, activation, rollback, upload, dispatch, production ring, or TUI authority.
